subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should OpenClaw accept this current-attempt replay metadata contract and server_error retry-before-failover behavior once full-runner proof is supplied?
rationale: The code shape appears to fix the bug narrowly, but it changes retry safety, message-delivery behavior, and a harness-visible attempt result shape, which requires owner acceptance rather than automated repair.

options.title: Require proof, then accept the contract
options.body: Ask for redacted full-runner or gateway logs showing retry recovery and no duplicate side effects, then proceed if the refreshed branch remains clean.

options.title: Accept the behavior risk now
options.body: Maintain owner review can choose to land with the existing extracted proof, explicitly owning the retry-ordering and harness-contract risk.

options.title: Pause in favor of another candidate
options.body: If maintainers prefer a different per-attempt signal or the competing open candidate, leave this PR open or close it only after a viable replacement is selected.

recommendation.title: Require proof, then accept the contract
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted full-runner or gateway logs showing retry recovery and no duplicate side effects, then proceed if the refreshed branch remains clean.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest recent history signal for embedded runner terminal/replay behavior and the most likely owner for this retry contract choice.
